assertions.observations: Typed 'phone' in the combobox search and the dropdown filtered from 15 templates to 5 phone order templates (Confirmation, Shipped with Tracking, Under $500 Request, Corporate Approval, Inter-Store Notification). Typing 'back' filtered to 'Back in Stock'. Search filtering works correctly via shadcn Command/Combobox.

All 15 templates visible when dropdown opened with empty search: New Customer Welcome, Back in Stock, Thank You + Warranty, New Model Arrival, Limited Edition, VIP Reconnection, Weekly Sale (7 customer email), Confirmation, Shipped with Tracking, Under $500 Request, Corporate Approval, Inter-Store Notification (5 phone orders), Availability Response, Thank You, Sale Alert (3 text). Each loads its specific fields when selected.

After saving a profile with Name='Test User', Job Title='General Manager', Company Email='manager@citizenwatchgroup.com', Store Name='Test Store', etc., selecting 'New Customer Welcome' template auto-populated the Employee Name field with 'Test User' from the saved profile.
